# BonniePdfLicenseError

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Thrown when the library is asked to generate a document without a licence declaration, in an environment positively identified as development, test, or CI.

It is never thrown in production or in an unclassifiable environment — there the notice degrades to a one-time warning, so that a live workload which happens never to have declared a tier keeps running. See `classifyEnvironment` for how that decision is made.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `Error`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new BonniePdfLicenseError(message: string)
```
